reason: Universe khoảng 1.686-1.745 mã và BCTC khoảng 1.494 mã; Phase 1.5 tránh quét database/file lớn chỉ để enumerate.

per_ticker_contract.has_price: true when ticker exists in ohlcv
per_ticker_contract.has_financial: true when ticker has raw BCTC or financial_snapshot rows
per_ticker_contract.has_metadata: true when ticker exists in metadata
per_ticker_contract.has_news_if_available: unknown unless an explicit ticker mapping is derived; news schema has no ticker field
per_ticker_contract.has_shareholder_if_available: true when ticker exists in shareholders; false/unknown must distinguish empty progress from not queried

availability_rules: Do not infer current tradability from has_price alone.
For live analysis require ticker date equal to the latest market snapshot date and inspect exchange/margin status.
Do not equate missing shareholders with zero ownership; inspect shareholders_progress when querying DB.
Do not claim ticker-specific news without a separate validated entity-linking step.
